title: Large requests to api.anthropic.com are now gzip compressed even with telemetry disabled, breaking some proxies
symptoms: A proxy or inspection layer in front of api.anthropic.com rejects or cannot read request bodies after upgrading
Request bodies show Content-Encoding gzip when telemetry is off
cause: From 2.1.300, large requests to api.anthropic.com use gzip compression regardless of telemetry setting.
fix: Disable gzip request bodies, or make the proxy accept gzip.
